description: In combination with `piClim-control`, quantifies present-day non-CH4 tropospheric ozone and aerosol effective radiative forcing (ERF). Same as `piClim-control`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor (NMVOCs, CO, NOx) and aerosol and aerosol precursor (BC, OC, NH3, SO2) emissions use present-day values (2021 values for CMIP7).
branch_information: Use the same branch point as you used for `piClim-control`
